::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 16 1863  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1863/3
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd),

I have at length obtained the account for the [Biographies](cmy_books/cmybook_43.qmd) and am glad to be able to send you the enclosed as your share of the proceeds. Your [account](other_books/otherbook_342.qmd) of the Procession was in time, and is going in this month with an [Illumination story](other_books/otherbook_343.qmd) of the last time London was in a blaze.

After this week please to add Elderfield before Otterbourn [sic] in our address. It is a cottage in the village we are going to move to, as [my brother](people/person_1624.qmd)’s family are beginning to outgrow our house

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Envelope addressed to Miss Smith/ 8 Wellington Road/ Old Charlton/ Se and postmarked Winchester (date illegible) and London SE 17 March 1863.
